sloka: जटायुषो यदि भ्राता श्रुतम् ते गदितम् मया ।आख्याहि यदि जानासि निलयम् तस्य रक्षसः ॥४-५८-९॥
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo yadi bhrātā śrutam te gaditam mayā ।ākhyāhi yadi jānāsi nilayam tasya rakṣasaḥ ॥4-58-9॥

translations.english: 'I have heard you. If you are the brother of Jatayu, tell us about the abode of that demon if you know.
